Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Hide the traces of your camp in ten minutes and give your group 2 Boons to conceal its trail during the first hour of travel.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Time
Ten minutes while clearing a departed campsite.
Target / range / shape
One departed campsite used by your party.
Type
Skill / Utility

Camouflage the ordinary traces of the departed camp. You and up to six companions gain 2 Boons to attribute rolls concealing your departure trail during the first hour of travel from it.
